attributes.action: Bank Holiday after England Football Team World Cup last 16 match vs Mexico
attributes.additional_details:
England play Mexico in the last 16 of the World Cup on Monday 6th July at 1.00am in the early morning.
In order to allow all the millions of fans to support the National Football Team, could the Government consider a Bank Holiday on 6th July, 2026.
attributes.background: I would like the Government to consider Monday 6th July as a Bank Holiday to allow England fans to support the National Football team in their World Cup last 16 vs Mexico

rejection.details: When our team got to your petition in the petitions queue, the date of the England vs Mexico World Cup game had already passed.
